'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Reid Smith DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet name '''Smith''' / '''J Smith'''; username '''3MW088'''; dest [[Reid Smith]]. Fate Decide shield noted non-(V) on sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
* '''Username:''' 3MW088
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
